summary: Points often join with no bridge at all, most of all in inaugurals.
realLife: 45% of inaugural points joined the next by a plain cut, against 19% in State of the State addresses.
sources: docs/story/research/address-moves.md (Elections lane, Nov 24, 2026: 6 inaugurals and 6 State of the State addresses read whole, 175 points coded)
inGame: The `joins` flag on a section in data/english/outlines.json: a section without it starts a new paragraph (a hard cut), one with it stays in the paragraph.

turns.what: Every point is joined by a bridge word.
turns.writesBack: The speech reads as one argument.
